short_scenes.say: Do the voltages always add up?
short_scenes.narration: Volt measures the voltage across three resistors in a loop. Will they add up to the battery voltage?
Walk around the loop. Plus twelve through the battery, minus two, minus four, minus six. The sum is zero, every time.

short_scenes.name: Volt
short_scenes.narration: Voltage is like height. The battery lifts the charges up, and each resistor brings them down a little. Back at the start, you're at the same height: total up equals total down.

short_scenes.name: Volt
short_scenes.narration: Around any closed loop, the rises equal the drops. It's conservation of energy.

short_scenes.name: Volt
short_scenes.say: Watch the full video: Kirchhoff's voltage law!
short_scenes.narration: For the detailed explanation, watch the full video on our channel. It's part of our complete Network Theory course.
